name: Project Status Report (EVM)
one_liner: The same one-page PSC dashboard, but with the project's performance expressed in Earned Value numbers.
purpose: A variant of the Project Status Report that reports performance using Earned Value Management. Guide Appendix C.15 describes EVM as a technique to monitor and control project performance, giving an objective view based on project financials, with both cost and value measured in cost units such as person days or euro. It adds the current-state indicators — Planned, Actual work, Earned Value (Progress) and Remaining work — plus a three-curve chart.
created_in: Executing Phase (Project Reporting, §7.4) — repeated every reporting cycle
approved_by: Project Owner (PO) is Accountable for Project Reporting; the report is submitted to the Project Steering Committee (PSC)
feeds: Control Cost and Control Schedule decisions

lifecycle.what: Time-phased baseline created; PV curve becomes measurable
PV, EV, AC recomputed each reporting cycle
SPI/CPI drive Control Schedule and Control Cost
Final variances quoted in the Project-End Report

items: Green curve: Planned effort (workdays) over weeks

fields.what: Single traffic light for the project. Note this template prints Yellow where template 19 prints Amber.
fields.who: PM proposes · PO owns the call

fields.f: Project Owner (PO) / Business Manager (BM) / Solution Provider (SP) / Project Manager (PM)
fields.what: The four named Directing- and Managing-Layer roles. Unlike template 19 there is no Phase field.
fields.castor: PO Florence Nightingale · BM Grace Hopper · SP Leonardo da Vinci · PM (ESM PSO)

fields.what: Panel title for the EVM graph that occupies the top-right of the page.
fields.castor: Cumulative workdays plotted weekly, weeks 1–38 of Executing

fields.f: Schedule: Green/Yellow/Red + Baselined / Forecasted delivery date + Variance
fields.what: Calendar view of schedule: approved baseline date, current forecast date, and the gap in months.

fields.f: Cost: Green/Yellow/Red + Baselined / Spent / Forecasted + Variance %
fields.what: Cost in workdays and euro against the baseline, with variance expressed as a percentage of forecast over baseline.
Traffic light for the current-state EVM block, driven by the SPI and CPI values below.
Total baselined budget of the project. Formula: BAC = total time-phased baseline. Note: the Guide never uses the term BAC.
Cost planned to be consumed until a point in time; an approved cost estimate of resources scheduled, time-phased and cumulative. Also BCWS.
fields.who: PM; from baselined Project Work Plan

fields.what: Value of the work performed expressed in budgetary terms — the percentage of the approved budget earned by actual work completed. Also BCWP.
Cost actually incurred until a given point in time, e.g. within a predefined reporting period. Also ACWP.
fields.who: PM with PSO/finance timesheet and invoice data

fields.what: Work still to be earned against the baseline. Formula: Remaining work = BAC − EV.
How far ahead or behind the baseline in value terms. Formula: SV = EV − PV. Negative means behind schedule.
How far under or over budget the work performed is. Formula: CV = EV − AC. Negative means over budget.
Schedule efficiency of work accomplished to date. Formula: SPI = EV ÷ PV. Below 1,00 means behind schedule.
Cost efficiency of work accomplished to date; the Guide prints it as Ratio=(Progress/Actual effort)*100. Under 100% means over budget.
Forecast total cost of the project. Named in Guide C.15 as a forecasting KPI; formula EAC = BAC ÷ CPI.
fields.who: PM forecasts · PO approves the re-forecast

fields.what: Forecast cost of the work still to be done. Named in Guide C.15; formula ETC = EAC − AC.
Efficiency the team must now achieve to still finish on budget. Named in Guide C.15; formula TCPI = (BAC − EV) ÷ (BAC − AC).
Up to six dated milestones — one more slot than template 19 provides.
fields.castor: 26/03/27 Release 1 — product configuration engine · 17/12/27 Release 2 — straight-through disbursement

fields.what: Traffic light, count of severe changes, then up to three lines of id, category and status.
fields.who: PM; source is the Change Log
fields.castor: Yellow · Severe: 1 · CR-007, category Scope, status Postponed

fields.what: Traffic light, count of active risks, then up to three lines of id, level and action.
fields.who: PM; source is the Risk Log
fields.castor: Yellow · Active: 9 · R-07, level High, action retention and knowledge-transfer clause with Levallois

fields.what: Traffic light, count of urgent issues, then up to three lines of id, size and severity.
fields.who: PM; source is the Issue Log
fields.castor: Yellow · Urgent: 2 · I-08, size Medium, severity High

fields.f: Green curve: Planned effort (workdays) over weeks
fields.what: The PV curve — the time-phased baseline plotted cumulatively week by week.
fields.who: PM; from baselined Project Work Plan

fields.what: The AC curve — actual effort or cost consumed to date, plotted cumulatively.
fields.castor: Reaches 1.188 PD at week 38 — above the green curve

fields.what: The EV curve — value of completed work. Below green means behind schedule; below red means over budget.
fields.castor: Reaches 1.070 PD at week 38 — below both other curves

fields.what: Up to three key actions performed with status, then up to three planned for the next period.
fields.castor: Performed: Release 1 delivered to acceptance, complete. Planned: table the Release 2 recovery plan on 23 Apr 2027.

traps: No RASCI of its own: the Project Reporting row governs (p.59) — PO=A, PM=R, PSC=I.
This template prints Green/Yellow/Red; template 19 prints Green/Amber/Red. Same idea, different words.
It drops the Phase field and the whole Decisions block that template 19 carries.
Cost here is Baselined/Spent/Forecasted overall; template 19 splits Current Year vs Overall project.
Guide C.15 (p.104) names PV, EV, AC, SV, SPI, CV, CPI, EAC, ETC, TCPI but prints no formulas.
